Hi Rachel — thanks for the sample and the clear questions. Quick answers below, plus I've pasted a minimal example you can use for E2E tests.

High level: portal is preferred (better metadata, fewer edge cases), email fallback is supported but requires stricter conventions to avoid manual triage.

A) Required subject tokens for email fallback (recommended exact format):
- SUBJECT: Invoice Submission | PO:{PO_NUMBER} | SUPPLIER:{SUPPLIER_NAME}
Example: "Invoice Submission | PO:PO-4492 | SUPPLIER:StarlitePay"

B) Filename conventions (for best automated parsing):
- invoice_{PO_NUMBER}_{INVOICE_NUMBER}.pdf
Example: invoice_PO-4492_INV-2027-009.pdf

C) Minimal email payload that triggers auto-ack: (please use plain text body + attachment)
---BEGIN SAMPLE EMAIL---
From: invoices@starlitepay.com
To: invoices@redwoodinference.com
Subject: Invoice Submission | PO:PO-4492 | SUPPLIER:StarlitePay

Body: Invoice attached. PO: PO-4492
Attachment: invoice_PO-4492_INV-2027-009.pdf
---END SAMPLE EMAIL---

D) PO location: we strongly prefer PO present in both the subject token and the filename. If the PO is only in the PDF body it increases false-negative matches by ~8% in our QA (we log these as exceptions).

E) Auto-ack behavior: you will receive two messages: an immediate receipt acknowledgement (bounce-safe) followed by a parsed status after ingestion (success / exception with reason). The receipt subject will be: "Redwood Receipt: {original-subject} | msgid:{id}". The ingestion result will be: "Redwood Ingest: {status} | PO:{PO_NUMBER} | INV:{INVOICE_NUMBER}".

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa on the attachment naming/edge-case logic — they own the exceptions playbook. If you want, we can also provide a sandbox mailbox for you to send tests to and watch the ack chain live.

Best,

Thanks Vanessa — quick technical notes from the ingestion side:

1) Ack payload: we can include a machine-readable JSON attachment in the receipt ack. Format suggestion: {"msgid":"<redwood-msg-id>","received_at":"2027-01-24T17:28:00Z","parsing_status":"received"}
2) We already support subject token parsing for PO: and SUPPLIER: prefixes; please ask partners to keep tokens in the first 120 chars of the subject to avoid truncation by long email threads.
3) Filename parsing: apply regex invoice_(?P<po>[^_]+)_(?P<inv>[^.]+)\.pdf — this handles most vendor patterns.
4) If PO only in PDF: we can do OCR-first-pass but it adds ~2 seconds/attachment and increases exceptions; prefer sandbox-only for that path.

I'll publish a short test checklist (curl + sample raw email) to the shared doc link and attach here.
